_comment: Minimal Alter Accord envelope. JSON mirror of the normative CBOR/COSE form spelled out in draft-morrison-identity-accord-00 (Alter Accord Implementation Plan §Normative). Both parties sign the canonical serialisation with their Instrument-tier Ed25519 key; signatures are appended in `signatures[]` at handshake time, not stored in this template.

consent_gates.note: Illustrative gates for a flow that reads no member data. A production accord sets each gate from what the two parties actually consented to, and re-validates them at settlement.

split.note: 75/5/15/5 = 10000 bps. A flow with no member has no payee for the 7500 bps member share; this example leaves it unallocated and a production flow resolves it before settlement.
